Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

several pages linked in the menu below for reference as we continue to transition this site.

combines industry-leading technology, service, and quality to serve over 100,000 cases annually. Our
team of board-certified neurologists and neurophysiologists are highly trained professionals aiming

## Medical Devices & Solutions

[Spine Solutions - Spine Procedures]

## [Spinal Solutions][77]

Orthofix’s complete spine portfolio provides reconstructive and regenerative solutions that aim to
restore the quality of life for patients with various spinal and bone-related conditions. Our
innovative solutions uniquely incorporate different treatment modalities (mechanical, biological and
electromagnetic) to achieve desired clinical outcomes. Our goal is to help patients maintain their
range of motion or achieve successful spinal fusions.

[Spinal Solutions][78]  | [Biologics][79]  |  [Spinal Fusion Therapy][80]

[Orthopedic]

## [Limb Reconstruction][81]

Orthofix is an industry leader with a unique portfolio of limb reconstruction solutions, addressing
the most challenging congenital, developmental, and acquired orthopedic conditions in patients of
all ages.

We remain focused on the complete patient pathway, supporting clinicians and patients through
continuous innovation of hardware and enabling technologies, clinical evidence and industry-leading
medical education programs.

[Limb Reconstruction][82]  |  [Biologics ][83]

[surgical procedure]

## [Surgical Navigation][84]

The 7D FLASH™ Navigation System revolutionizes surgical precision by combining unmatched accuracy,
efficient workflow and a reduced to completely radiation-free experience. Its machine-vision
technology rapidly captures and reconstructs a highly detailed 3D image, ensuring precise
navigation. FLASH Registration streamlines workflow, reducing patient registration time from 30
minutes to as little as 30 seconds, allowing surgeons to focus entirely on the patient rather than
cumbersome technology. With a fully sterile-field-controlled interface, the system eliminates
reliance on additional staff, enhancing surgical autonomy and efficiency. By delivering superior
accuracy with a seamless workflow, 7D FLASH Navigation empowers surgeons to operate with confidence
while prioritizing patient safety — and continues to innovate boldly, redefining the future of
surgical navigation.

[Spine Navigation System][85] | [Cranial Navigation System][86]
[7D FLASH EVD][87]

## [Therapeutic Solutions][88]

Orthofix Therapeutic Solutions are redefining recovery through a diverse, coordinated portfolio that
brings together non-invasive bone growth therapies, bracing solutions, and dedicated patient support
through a single, trusted partner. Our approach streamlines access to multiple recovery tools,
creating a more seamless experience for providers and patients. With decades of experience
supporting recovery pathways and a legacy grounded in clinical evidence, Orthofix Therapeutic
Solutions are designed to help keep patients engaged and supported throughout their healing journey.

[Bone Growth Therapies][89] | [Bracing Solutions][90]

## Corporate Responsibility

[Trees in the forest]

### Environmental Sustainability

Orthofix is committed to responsible environmental practices that include conservation of natural
resources, pollution prevention, and reduction of waste. As climate change concerns become more
prevalent, we recognize the need to comply with increased regulations and stricter environmental
standards. We believe that our focus on environmental sustainability, with the objective of reducing
costs and improving sustainability of our operations, will provide a strategic benefit.

[Learn More][91]
[diverse business team putting hands together]

### Diversity & Inclusion

Our commitment starts with attracting, retaining, and developing a workforce that is diverse in
background, knowledge, skill, and experience. We are committed to providing equal employment
opportunities, and make all recruiting, payment, performance and promotion decisions based on merit,
without discrimination on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, age, family status, ethnic
origin, nationality, disability or religious belief.

[Learn More][92]
[Social Responsibility and Community Involvement]

### Community Involvement

We don’t just make a difference in the lives of patients and their families; we make a difference in
our communities. Through our employees, Orthofix contributes hundreds of hours in hands-on
assistance and resources to philanthropic organizations around the world in addition to donations,
fundraising efforts and local community development.

[Learn More][93]

## Join Us.

At Orthofix, we are proud of the work our employees do around the world. Our global team is
empowered to make a difference in the lives of patients and those in our community through work,
volunteer activities, charitable giving and employee programs. After all, the success of our company
is built on the efforts of our most important resources: our people.

Solutions are designed to help keep patients engaged and supported throughout their healing journey.

[Bone Growth Therapies][89] | [Bracing Solutions][90]

## Corporate Responsibility

[Trees in the forest]

### Environmental Sustainability

Orthofix is committed to responsible environmental practices that include conservation of natural
resources, pollution prevention, and reduction of waste. As climate change concerns become more
prevalent, we recognize the need to comply with increased regulations and stricter environmental
standards. We believe that our focus on environmental sustainability, with the objective of reducing
costs and improving sustainability of our operations, will provide a strategic benefit.

[Learn More][91]
[diverse business team putting hands together]

### Diversity & Inclusion

Our commitment starts with attracting, retaining, and developing a workforce that is diverse in
background, knowledge, skill, and experience. We are committed to providing equal employment
opportunities, and make all recruiting, payment, performance and promotion decisions based on merit,
without discrimination on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, age, family status, ethnic
origin, nationality, disability or religious belief.

[Learn More][92]
[Social Responsibility and Community Involvement]

### Community Involvement

We don’t just make a difference in the lives of patients and their families; we make a difference in
our communities. Through our employees, Orthofix contributes hundreds of hours in hands-on
assistance and resources to philanthropic organizations around the world in addition to donations,
fundraising efforts and local community development.

[Learn More][93]

Careers

## Join Us.

At Orthofix, we are proud of the work our employees do around the world. Our global team is
empowered to make a difference in the lives of patients and those in our community through work,
volunteer activities, charitable giving and employee programs. After all, the success of our company
is built on the efforts of our most important resources: our people.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

# Restore Active Living^{®}

Leading hyaluronic acid innovation in orthopedic regenerative solutions and osteoarthritis pain
management

[Our Technology][52][About Us][53]

Discover how our hyaluronic acid (HA) innovations help restore active living

### Regenerative Solutions

Advanced HA-based orthopedic regenerative solutions that harness your body’s innate ability to heal

[Discover Regenerative Solutions][54]

### Osteoarthritis Pain Management

Reduce the pain of osteoarthritis (OA) and improve mobility with proven hyaluronic acid treatments

[Discover OA Pain Management][55]

### Our Technology Platform

Explore how our proprietary hyaluronic acid technology fuels next-generation treatments

[Discover Our Technology Platform][56]

## Our Products

Comprehensive regenerative solutions and osteoarthritis pain management treatments

[
[Regenerative Solutions]

### Regenerative Solutions

Advanced tissue repair and regeneration

][57] [ Integrity^{™} Rotator cuff and tendon repair augmentation ][58] [ Hyalofast^{®} Cartilage
regeneration scaffold ][59] [ Tactoset^{®} Injectable bone substitute ][60] [ NanoFx^{®} Advanced
bone marrow stimulation ][61]
[
[OA Pain Management]

### OA Pain Management

Non-opioid hyaluronic acid (HA) injections for osteoarthritis

][62] [ Cingal^{®} Next generation combination HA + steroid single injection ][63] [ Monovisc^{®}
Single-injection HA viscosupplement ][64] [ Orthovisc^{®} Multi-injection HA viscosupplement ][65]

“Integrity significantly **enhances both the strength and biological support** in rotator cuff
repairs. **Patient outcomes have been outstanding** with postoperative imaging showing **thickening
of the rotator cuff repair.** Patients are also consistently able to return to their desired
activities in life **without restrictions.**“

Christopher E. Baker, MD, Florida Orthopaedic Institute
[Christopher E. Baker, MD]

“Cingal combines two proven, approved therapies for pain and inflammation into a single injection
treatment that has been shown to provide immediate pain relief that lasts for 6 months, reduce
stiffness, and improve function.

For knee pain sufferers, Cingal not only translates to postponing an invasive and costly knee
replacement surgery, but also to enabling these individuals to resume their normal lifestyle prior
to the onset of chronic pain.”

Prof. Laszlo Hangody, MD, Ph.D., DSc., Uzsoki Hospital Orthopedic & Trauma Department Budapest,
Hungary
[Prof. Laszlo Hangody, MD, Ph.D., DSc.]

## Why Anika?

Together, we restore active living and redefine what’s possible with hyaluronic acid (HA).

[Compass logo with blue star design and text "Driven by Purpose, Powered by Science" around the
perimeter.]
[icon-hyaluronic-acid-expertise]

30+ years pioneering HA-based orthopedic solutions validated through real-world results

[icon-innovation-leader]

### Innovation Leader

Continuous advancement to redefine what’s possible with HA-based solutions

[icon-clinicallyproven]

### Clinically Proven

Robust clinical data supporting product safety and efficacy

[icon-global-reach]

### Global Reach

Products available worldwide in 45+ countries

# Your premier option for market access solutions across Asia.

Asia Actual provides medical device registration, authorized representative services, and
independent license holding across Asia Pacific. We serve as the local regulatory representative in
16 APAC markets, supporting regulatory market access for medical device and IVD manufacturers.
[ Australia ][68] [ Bangladesh ][69] [ China ][70] [ Hong Kong ][71] [ India ][72] [ Indonesia ][73]
[ Japan ][74] [ Malaysia ][75] [ Philippines ][76] [ Singapore ][77] [ South Korea ][78] [ Taiwan
][79] [ Thailand ][80] [ Vietnam ][81] [ New Zealand ][82] [ Sri Lanka ][83]
[ Discover all
][84]

## Core Services

[

### Independent License Holding

Keep ownership of the registration certificates away from commercial partners to optimize sales
channel management, IP protection, and regulatory support.
][85] [

### Device Registration

Work directly with leading, local regulatory experts in each market who are dedicated to your
medical device registrations, maintenance, and renewals.
][86] [

### Post-Market Vigilance

Secure peace of mind that critical, time-sensitive actions are managed by experienced regulatory
professional in each market whenever required.
][87] [

### Importing & Customs Clearance

Eliminate costly delays and gain specialized clarity into importing costs and processes.
][88] [

### Commercial Support

Solve sales channel problems with seasoned local experts.
][89]
Browse all of our services
[View more][90]

## Our Mission

To provide a stable, reliable local platform so that our clients can grow their businesses in
challenging Asian markets. We strive to provide the fastest market access and customs clearance for
important medical device innovations.
[View more][91]

## We distinguish ourselves with

### Outstanding personnel

Asia Actual regulatory and business managers average at 21 years of experience in the medical device
industry
“Our experience working with Asia Actual is that the team is composed of highly competent,
communicative, and knowledgeable staff. This has improved our time to market across many geographies
and allowed us to take control of our device registrations.”
Charles DeNault
Associate Director Regulatory Affairs,
Penumbra

### Clear communication

Our offices are staffed by experienced, bilingual consultants who have worked with and for
multinational companies
“We changed regulatory consultants in India due to constant communication problems, and now Gunjan
and her team saved our project.”
Shay Levav
Vice President Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs and Clinical,
IceCure Medical Ltd.

### Transparent operations

Our importing protocols include per-shipment expense reporting
“We were looking to find a regulatory partner in the Asian markets which fit our business operations
more efficiently than those we had been working with in the past or evaluating previously. In our
search we talked with then implemented a few trial registration projects with Asia Actual; their
direct contacts in country, clarity and continuous contact approach fit much better with our needs
to get first-hand information without having to go multiple tiers of relationships. This approach
allows us to get applications in the hands of the regulators more quickly and product to market on
time. We are continuing to expand our engagement with Asia Actual to more countries in Asia to get
our products to market on time.”
Jim Rosa
Senio

* “The team at Asia Actual has seamlessly guided us through the intricate process of compliance to

  in an increasingly competitive industry.”

  complicated undertaking. The local in-country teams at Asia Actual really did a fantastic job at
  making our submissions painless. They knew exactly the content needed by the local authorities.

  the local requirements. In one instance, we needed to complete a registration with an aggressive
  timeline. The Asia Actual team worked with the local authorities to push our submission, and we
  completed the device registration on time.”
  Brian Brown

# Transforming Healthcare with Personalized 3D-Printed Implants 

We hold proprietary expertise in 3D printing of osseointegrative materials, AI-based planning and
design automation tools, and digital health solutions to provide seamless data-backed care to
optimize individual patient outcomes. Our solutions are as unique as the patients and surgeons we
assist — because one size doesn’t fit all. 

[Healthcare Professionals][26][Patients][27]
[ Play Video ][28]

Our personalized 3D printed orthopaedic implants enable surgeons to repair the human body in
innovative new ways. Each product is expertly designed based on scientific research and manufactured
using the latest advanced technology. 

## Personalized Precision 

restor3d delivers patient-specific 3D-printed implants, tailored to each individual’s anatomy,
ensuring better fit, function, and surgical outcomes.  

## Enabling Technologies 

Combining advanced 3D printing, AI-driven design, and digital health solutions, restor3d leads
personalized musculoskeletal reconstruction with efficient, scalable care. 

## Unmatched Expertise 

Restor3d operates on a data first approach to enhance implant architecture with expertise in
osseointegrative biomaterials. 

Healthcare Professionals

## Our Technology is Elevating Orthopaedic Surgery 

Achieve superior anatomical fit to repair and restore patients based on their unique anatomy with
tools for pre-surgical planning, precise cut and implant placement. 

[Healthcare Professionals][29]

### Foot and Ankle

Scientifically developed foot & ankle solutions for Total Ankle Replacement and beyond. 

### Knee 

Personalized total knee solutions to ensure patient satisfaction and mobility. 

### Hip

Total hip personalization offers patient specific planning and personalized instrumentation. 

#### Personalized devices are designed to match your unique anatomy.  

[Patients][30]

Our Mission

## Every patient deserves personalized care 

At restor3d, we understand that the patient’s journey extends far beyond the operating room. It
encompasses every aspect of care, from the initial consultation to post-operative recovery. That’s
why we are dedicated to creating personalized, 3D-printed implants that not only meet the unique
anatomical needs of each patient but also enhance overall post-operative experience. By putting the
patient at the heart of everything we do, we ensure that every step of their journey is as seamless
and supportive as possible. 

[Our Company ][31]

## Contact Us

### How can we help you?

Biomechanics, and AI

THE POWER

TO WIN

THE POWER
TO WIN

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

### Need Help Finding Care?
### Our 24/7 Contact Center is Here for You!

### SCAN ME

We understand that finding the right care can be challenging. That’s why our dedicated team is
available 24/7 to provide support and assistance. Whether you need to schedule an appointment or
have questions about our services, we’re here to make it easy for you to get the care you need.

[ CALL NOW (0917) 466-2273 ][153]

# Why our kind of care is what you need

### Humanized Healthcare for Everyone

Behind your health condition, HMN understands who you are – a person with varying, complex needs.
That’s why we take time to get to know you, so we can provide better care for you.

### We Give Our All, For One

Every patient gets a team of healthcare providers combining their expertise to address your complete
healthcare needs. This is how our team of doctors, nurses, and staff work together to make you feel
better holistically.

# What Patients Say About Their Experience With Us

"Natutuwa ako doon sa mga tao doon. Talagang accommodating sila, kahit saan, sa X-ray room, talagang
ineentertain nila yung mga pasyente. Pagka may tanong ang pasyente, kunyari mga naghihintay,
talagang sinasagot nila, ineexplain nila."

kanya"

Each Step We Care
At United Orthopedic, we provide superior service to our surgeon customers by being more responsive,
agile, and versatile. We listen to surgeons carefully and are uniquely able to meet their unmet
needs through a vertically integrated manufacturing process that allows us to control every critical
step of the process in order to bring our products to market more efficiently. For over 25 years,
United has built a reputation for caring about surgeons, other health care providers, and patients
around the world with a broad portfolio of safe, reliable products designed and produced with care
at every step.
[ About United ][37]

### Patients

We show that we care about our patients by continuously improving our product development and
manufacturing processes in order to deliver high quality surgical solutions.

[Surgeons icon]

### Surgeon Customers

We show that we care about our surgeon customers by carefully listening to their needs and quickly
delivering solutions to assist them in achieving successful clinical outcomes.

### Healthcare Partners

We show that we care about our healthcare partners by providing versatile, cost-effective product
options which are designed to deliver effective surgical solutions.

### World-Class Quality Driven By Vertically-Integrated Manufacturing

United Orthopedic is committed to manufacturing and distributing products of high quality, as well
as ensuring the same high quality in the service and support that we provide to our customers. Our
integrated manufacturing process enables our engineers to design, develop, and manufacture
feature-rich medical device products that deliver clinical success with high-value surgical
solutions that benefit hospitals, surgeons and their patients.
[ Learn More ][38]

## Hip System

#### Offers surgeons the ability to meet various patient needs through providing a comprehensive
#### portfolio of stem and cup products from bone stock preservation to complex revision
#### arthroplasty.

[ Learn More ][39]

## Knee System

#### Provides surgeons with innovative designs and a comprehensive suite of implant options to
#### accommodate a wide variety of bone conditions within primary, revision and more complex
#### surgical cases.

[ Learn More ][40]

## Limb Salvage

#### Offers surgeons a simpler solution for complex salvage cases through its innovative mechanisms
#### and modular design.

[ Learn More ][41]

## Innovation Pipelines

#### Engineering novel and award winning instruments have been designed to help enhance surgical
#### efficiency, reduce surgical complexities and create valuable benefits to hospitals and surgeons
#### without sacrificing patient outcomes and overall service quality.

[ Learn More ][42]

Each Step We Care
At United Orthopedic, we provide superior service to our surgeon customers by being more responsive,
agile, and versatile. We listen to surgeons carefully and are uniquely able to meet their unmet
needs through a vertically integrated manufacturing process that allows us to control every critical
step of the process in order to bring our products to market more efficiently. For over 25 years,
United has built a reputation for caring about surgeons, other health care providers, and patients
around the world with a broad portfolio of safe, reliable products designed and produced with care
at every step.
[ About United ][37]

### Patients

We show that we care about our patients by continuously improving our product development and
manufacturing processes in order to deliver high quality surgical solutions.

[Surgeons icon]

### Surgeon Customers

We show that we care about our surgeon customers by carefully listening to their needs and quickly
delivering solutions to assist them in achieving successful clinical outcomes.

### Healthcare Partners

We show that we care about our healthcare partners by providing versatile, cost-effective product
options which are designed to deliver effective surgical solutions.

### World-Class Quality Driven By Vertically-Integrated Manufacturing

United Orthopedic is committed to manufacturing and distributing products of high quality, as well
as ensuring the same high quality in the service and support that we provide to our customers. Our
integrated manufacturing process enables our engineers to design, develop, and manufacture
feature-rich medical device products that deliver clinical success with high-value surgical
solutions that benefit hospitals, surgeons and their patients.
[ Learn More ][38]

## Hip System

#### Offers surgeons the ability to meet various patient needs through providing a comprehensive
#### portfolio of stem and cup products from bone stock preservation to complex revision
#### arthroplasty.

[ Learn More ][39]

## Knee System

#### Provides surgeons with innovative designs and a comprehensive suite of implant options to
#### accommodate a wide variety of bone conditions within primary, revision and more complex
#### surgical cases.

[ Learn More ][40]

## Limb Salvage

#### Offers surgeons a simpler solution for complex salvage cases through its innovative mechanisms
#### and modular design.

[ Learn More ][41]

## Innovation Pipelines

#### Engineering novel and award winning instruments have been designed to help enhance surgical
#### efficiency, reduce surgical complexities and create valuable benefits to hospitals and surgeons
#### without sacrificing patient outcomes and overall service quality.

[ Learn More ][42]

Evaluating the success and performance of United Orthopedic’s devices one patient at a time.

# ***About Us***

Just Medical Devices (Tianjin) Co., Ltd.

Just Medical Devices (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. specializes in joint diseases, focusing on joint
prostheses, clinical surgical robots, and innovative biomaterials. We are a leading enterprise in
the field of artificial joints in China.

As China's high-tech enterprise, we've been dedicated to technological innovation for years. We have
5 major R&D centers across Tianjin, Beijing, Shanghai, and the United States. We've also established
the Tianjin Enterprise Key Laboratory and Technology Center to foster industry-academia
collaboration, speeding up the transition of our technological advancements into practical
applications. We are committed to providing safe, effective, and exquisite medical products and
services to the greatest extent possible.

Providing safe, effective and exquisite medical products and service.

Minimally invasive, primary, complex primary, revision, and 3D customized products

▪ World's first: 3D-printed trabecular modular femoral stem has been clinically validated and

# ***About Us***

Just Medical Devices (Tianjin) Co., Ltd.

Just Medical Devices (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. specializes in joint diseases, focusing on joint
prostheses, clinical surgical robots, and innovative biomaterials. We are a leading enterprise in
the field of artificial joints in China.

As China's high-tech enterprise, we've been dedicated to technological innovation for years. We have
5 major R&D centers across Tianjin, Beijing, Shanghai, and the United States. We've also established
the Tianjin Enterprise Key Laboratory and Technology Center to foster industry-academia
collaboration, speeding up the transition of our technological advancements into practical
applications. We are committed to providing safe, effective, and exquisite medical products and
services to the greatest extent possible.

# Michael B. Gerhardt, MD Orthopaedic SurgeonSports Medicine Specialist

Dr. Gerhardt is a board certified orthopaedic surgeon who joined Santa Monica Orthopaedic and Sports
Medicine Group in 2002. He specializes in sports medicine, which includes arthroscopic surgery of
the hip, knee, ankle and shoulder. Dr. Gerhardt has also completed sub-specialty training in hip
arthroscopy.

[ [Mako Robotic-Arm Assisted Technology For Hip And Knee Replacement Surgery]][59]
Mako Robotic-arm Assisted Technology for Hip & Knee Replacement Surgery

The Mako Robotic-Arm Assisted Technology helps your surgeon create a 3D model of your knee or hip,
which can be used to develop a highly precise surgical plan to ensure accurate placement of the
implant within the joint ensuring a long lasting and well-fitting prosthesis.

Am I Candidate for Robotic-Assisted Surgery?
You may be a candidate if you have:
* Osteoarthritis of the knee
* Degenerative joint disease of the hip
* Loss of joint function
* No relief from conservative care

[ [Mako Robotic-Arm Assisted Technology For Hip And Knee Replacement Surgery]][59]
Mako Robotic-arm Assisted Technology for Hip & Knee Replacement Surgery

The Mako Robotic-Arm Assisted Technology helps your surgeon create a 3D model of your knee or hip,
which can be used to develop a highly precise surgical plan to ensure accurate placement of the
implant within the joint ensuring a long lasting and well-fitting prosthesis.

Am I Candidate for Robotic-Assisted Surgery?
You may be a candidate if you have:
* Osteoarthritis of the knee
* Degenerative joint disease of the hip
* Loss of joint function
* No relief from conservative care

Complete pedicle screw-rod systems, TLIF/PLIF cages, cervical plates, and dynamic stabilization
implants designed for cervical, thoracic, and lumbar fusion procedures.

### Trauma Fixation Plates & Screws

Who We Are

## Precision Engineering Meets Clinical Excellence

Medispirex Orthopedic Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer specializing in **spine
and orthopedic implant solutions**, established in **2016** with a modern production facility
covering approximately **18,600㎡**. The company integrates R&D, manufacturing, and global
distribution to deliver high-quality medical devices for trauma, spine, and joint reconstruction
applications.

With an annual export revenue of approximately **USD 18 million**, Medispirex has built a stable
international presence supported by **7 years of export experience** and over **12 years of industry
expertise**. With a commitment to precision engineering and clinical performance, Medispirex
continues to develop advanced orthopedic and spinal solutions that meet international standards and
evolving surgical needs.

✅ ISO 13485 Certified ✅ CE Marked ✅ FDA Registered ✅ GMP Compliant ✅ 40+ Export Countries

Our fully integrated facility houses CNC machining centers, surface treatment lines, cleanrooms, and
in-house QC laboratories — all under one roof to ensure uncompromised product quality at every
stage.

## End-to-End In-House Production Process

Why Medispirex

## Six Pillars of Trust That Set Us Apart

Discover why leading hospitals, orthopedic surgeons, and medical distributors across 40+ countries
choose Medispirex as their long-term manufacturing partner.

🎯
12+ Years of Orthopedic Expertise

Over a decade of specialized knowledge in biomechanics, materials science, and surgical device
design ensures every implant we produce meets the highest clinical standards.

🔯
Rigorous 4-Stage Quality System

Incoming material inspection, in-process QC, final product testing, and batch traceability —
enforced by a 45-person dedicated quality assurance team.

🌎
Global Distribution Network

Stable export operations across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia with 7+
years of international trade experience.

🛠
Flexible OEM / ODM Capabilities

Private label manufacturing, product design adaptation, and surgical system configuration support —
tailored to meet each partner's unique market requirements.

🔌
860+ Supply Chain Partners

A robust upstream/downstream network of over 860 partners guarantees material security, production
stability, and on-time global delivery at scale.

📈
120+ New Products Per Year

Driven by 85 R&D engineers, our continuous innovation pipeline delivers over 120 new products
annually, keeping our partners at the cutting edge of orthopedic care.

Product Portfolio

## Comprehensive Spine & Orthopedic Implant Systems

From minimally invasive spinal instrumentation to complex joint reconstruction systems, our product
range covers every major orthopedic discipline with precision-engineered solutions.

[Medispirex spinal fusion implant system for cervical and lumbar surgery]
Spine

### Spinal Fusion & Instrumentation Systems

Complete pedicle screw-rod systems, TLIF/PLIF cages, cervical plates, and dynamic stabilization
implants designed for cervical, thoracic, and lumbar fusion procedures.

[Medispirex trauma fixation implant plate and screw system]
Trauma

### Trauma Fixation Plates & Screws

Locking compression plates, intramedullary nails, cannulated screws, and external fixation systems
engineered for reliable fracture management across all anatomical sites.

[Medispirex joint reconstruction implant system for hip and knee surgery]
Joint Reconstruction

### Joint Reconstruction Implants

Hip, knee, and shoulder arthroplasty systems with modular design options, featuring advanced bearing
surfaces and biocompatible titanium and cobalt-chrome alloys.

[🔍 View All Products][25] [📄 Download Full Catalog][26]
Quality Assurance

## International Compliance & Quality Certifications

Our quality management system exceeds international regulatory requirements, giving our global
partners absolute confidence in every implant we deliver.

🏅
ISO 13485 Certified

Full compliance with the international standard for Medical Device Quality Management Systems,
covering design, production, and post-market surveillance.

🇪🇺
CE Mark Certified

Products certified to European Medical Device Regulation (MDR 2017/745) standards, enabling direct
market access across all EU and EEA member states.

🇺🇸
FDA Registered

U.S. FDA establishment registration and 510(k) clearance pathways supported, meeting the rigorous
requirements of the world's most demanding medical device market.

📋
45-Person QC Team

A dedicated quality assurance workforce performing dimensional inspection, mechanical fatigue
testing, and material composition analysis on every production batch.

[📄 Request Quality Documentation][27]
R&D & Innovation

## Driven by Science. Designed for Surgeons.

Medispirex's innovation engine is powered by **85 specialized engineers** across biomechanics,
materials science, and orthopedic device design disciplines. Our in-house laboratory enables rapid
prototyping, rigorous mechanical validation, and accelerated regulatory submission timelines.

Launched approximately **120 new products in the past year** alone, our innovation pipeline is one
of the most productive in the orthopedic implant manufacturing sector. Every new design undergoes
dimensional inspection, mechanical fatigue testing under simulated physiological loads, and material
composition analysis before entering production.

## Trusted by Healthcare Systems Worldwide

From hospital bulk procurement to custom OEM surgical system development, our project delivery track
record spans 40+ countries with consistent quality and reliability.

Europe

### Multi-Hospital Spinal System Supply Program

Delivered complete pedicle screw-rod fusion systems to a regional hospital network across three
European countries, meeting CE MDR compliance and local sterilization requirements.

North America

### OEM Trauma Fixation System Development

Partnered with a U.S. orthopedic device distributor to develop a private-label locking plate system,
from engineering validation through 510(k) submission support and market launch.

Middle East

### Joint Reconstruction Implant Procurement

Supplied a complete range of hip and knee arthroplasty systems to a leading Middle Eastern medical
group, fulfilling bulk volume requirements with batch traceability documentation.

CE MDR 2017/745 compliant products serving hospitals and distributors across Germany, France, Italy,

A variety of proprietary, tissue-sparing approaches for total hip replacement that are designed to
reduce length of hospital stay.¹

###### FOR HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS

The Evolution® medial-pivot knee allows patients to get back to their lives faster.²

[Learn More][67]

## Evolution® NitrX™ Knee

###### FOR HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS

The Evolution® NitrX™ medial-pivot knee features a titanium niobium nitride (TiNbN) coating that has
been shown to reduce the release of cobalt (Co), chromium (Cr), nickel (Ni), and molybdenum (Mb)
ions common in standard CoCr implants.^{4  }The Evolution® NitrX™ knee maintains the kinematic
benefits of the medial-pivot design⁵, resulting in optimal stability.⁶

accurate, and verifiable through what we call N.E.X.T. Insights - so you can trust what you see.

Gelenkimplantate und OP-Instrumente** nach den neuesten medizinischen und technischen Standards.

und tragen zu erfolgreichen Implantationen bei.

langfristige Partnerschaften. Führende Hersteller und Distributoren weltweit vertrauen auf unsere

As leading manufacturers of orthopedic products, ORTHO CARE is at the forefront of innovation and
quality in the industry. Established in 1994 and based in Kirti Nagar Industrial Area, New Delhi, we
are committed to delivering superior solutions that enhance patient outcomes and support healthcare
professionals. Our extensive product range includes bone screws, bone plates, interlocking nails,
spinal implants, hip prosthesis, arthroscopy tools, power tools, and external fixators. Each product
is engineered with precision and crafted using state-of-the-art technology, ensuring exceptional
performance and reliability.

We are proud to be a USFDA 510K Cleared and CE certified company, adhering to the highest
international standards. Our compliance with ISO 13485 standards underscores our dedication to
excellence and quality assurance. At ORTHO CARE, our mission is to provide innovative orthopedic
solutions that meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a focus on quality, customer
satisfaction, and continuous improvement, we stand as a trusted partner in advancing orthopedic
care.

Locking plates are anatomically contoured orthopedic implants designed to provide angular stability
in complex and osteoporotic fractures. The fixed-angle construct enhances fixation strength,
minimizes screw loosening, and supports early mobilization.

Bone screws are high-strength orthopedic fixation devices manufactured for optimal thread engagement
and pull-out resistance. They provide secure fixation across trauma, reconstructive, and spinal
applications.

screw technology. They ensure accurate fracture alignment, load sharing, and reliable healing in
long bone fractures.

fusion procedures. Designed to restore spinal alignment and biomechanical stability, they meet
international standards for safety and performance.

and aesthetic outcomes.

procedures of the hand. They support precise alignment, stable fixation, and restoration of fine
motor function.

[Knee Replacement][58]

[A knee replacement is a surgical procedure in which the damaged or worn components of the knee
joint are replaced with artificial materials. The knee functions as a hinge, facilitating movement
between the thigh and lower leg. The surgery typically lasts about 1 to 1.5 hours, although recovery
times can vary significantly from patient to patient.][59]

[Hip Replacement][61]

[A hip replacement is a surgical procedure that replaces a damaged hip joint with an artificial
joint. During this process, the head of the femur is removed along with the surface layer of the
socket where it fits. The artificial components of the hip joint come in various shapes, sizes, and
designs, typically made from materials such as cobalt, ceramic, titanium, and chrome. Additionally,
some surgeons opt for customized components to ensure a better fit for the femur.][62]

spondylosis can occur at any level of the spine. Initial treatment options include exercise and
medication; however, if these measures do not provide relief, consulting your doctor is essential

[Knee Replacement][58]

[A knee replacement is a surgical procedure in which the damaged or worn components of the knee
joint are replaced with artificial materials. The knee functions as a hinge, facilitating movement
between the thigh and lower leg. The surgery typically lasts about 1 to 1.5 hours, although recovery
times can vary significantly from patient to patient.][59]

[[Knee replacement.jpg]][60]

[Hip Replacement][61]

[A hip replacement is a surgical procedure that replaces a damaged hip joint with an artificial
joint. During this process, the head of the femur is removed along with the surface layer of the
socket where it fits. The artificial components of the hip joint come in various shapes, sizes, and
designs, typically made from materials such as cobalt, ceramic, titanium, and chrome. Additionally,
some surgeons opt for customized components to ensure a better fit for the femur.][62]

[[Hip replacement.jpg]][63]

[Spine][66]

[Spondylosis refers to the gradual degeneration of the discs between the vertebrae in the spine, a
condition that becomes more common with age, particularly after 40. Similar to osteoarthritis, it
typically results from age-related wear and tear. While it most frequently affects the lower back,
spondylosis can occur at any level of the spine. Initial treatment options include exercise and
medication; however, if these measures do not provide relief, consulting your doctor is essential
for further evaluation and management.][67]

## Wherever you sit in the equipment lifecycle, we speak your language.

For Supply Chain & Finance

### Recover capital. Control risk.

Turn idle equipment into recovered value. Compliance-ready reporting. Predictable partner
performance across every facility.

What's the financial upside vs our current process?+

Most hospitals recover significantly more value through reLink than through traditional liquidation
or asset disposal vendors. Our multi-channel resale strategy matches each device to the right buyer
instead of selling at one liquidation floor price. Recovered value is reported in real time through
the reLink360 portal.

How does this fit with our existing Premier Inc. GPO contract?+

reLink Medical is a Premier Inc. Contracted Supplier under GPO Contract #COND-0210. Member hospitals
activate under existing terms and most member organizations are operational within 5–10 business
days.

How does reLink support our audit and risk requirements?+

Every disposition is documented end-to-end and accessible through the reLink360 portal — so your
audit and risk teams always have what they need, when they need it. reLink operates to HIPAA and ISO
9001:2015 standards, and documentation is available on demand rather than waiting on a request
cycle.

How is recovered value reported back to finance for reconciliation?+

Everything runs through the reLink360 portal in real time. Finance teams can view recovered value by
facility, device category, and disposition outcome — no waiting on monthly reports. Credits earned
can be applied toward new equipment purchases, technician training, or paid out as cash. Quarterly
business reviews add trend analysis and ROI context across your program.

What's the typical onboarding timeline for a multi-facility health system?+

Standard onboarding takes 5–10 business days for a single facility. Multi-facility health systems
are typically operational across all sites within 30–60 days, with phased rollout coordinated
through a dedicated reLink program manager.

[Executive overview →][36]
For Facilities & HTM

### Fast Sourcing. Smart Support.

When your equipment is down, we move — parts, whole units, and repair services built around your
timeline.

Can we source specific replacement parts or whole units quickly?+

Yes. reLinkOnline processes 13,000+ devices per month across every major modality — parts,
accessories, and whole units. For specific models or larger quantities, a Product Manager works
directly against our vendor network to track it down, including hard-to-find imaging and biomed
equipment.

What's the difference between reLink Certified refurbishment and OEM service?+

reLink Certified equipment is fully refurbished, biomed-tested, and warranty-backed — at a fraction
of OEM pricing. We follow the same calibration and PM procedures OEMs use, and biomed test reports
are available on request. You get the confidence of OEM-level work without the OEM timeline or cost.

How quickly can you respond to an urgent equipment need?+

Faster than you might expect. Our Product Managers work with a network of vendors and can typically
match an urgent need within 1–3 business days. For time-sensitive situations, reach out directly —
we'll tell you quickly what's available and what we can move.

Yes. We scope and coordinate fleet conversions, fixed imaging removals — MRI, CT, cath labs —

Most hospitals recover significantly more value through reLink than through traditional liquidation
or asset disposal vendors. Our multi-channel resale strategy matches each device to the right buyer
instead of selling at one liquidation floor price. Recovered value is reported in real time through
the reLink360 portal.

reLink Medical is a Premier Inc. Contracted Supplier under GPO Contract #COND-0210. Member hospitals

audit and risk teams always have what they need, when they need it. reLink operates to HIPAA and ISO
9001:2015 standards, and documentation is available on demand rather than waiting on a request
cycle.

business reviews add trend analysis and ROI context across your program.

From humble beginnings to building an empire, Shalby Ltd. is a story of commitment towards providing
the best in healthcare. What began as a small orthopedic centre in 1994 with six beds, one operation
theatre, and a small staff, is today a chain of 16 hospitals present in 13 Indian cities across 8
states. The group also encompasses diverse business verticals, all dedicated towards transforming
the medical landscape of India.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

#### Data Collection

sources.

indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

About the firm

## National Class Action & Trial Lawyers

Federal and state courts frequently appoint the Firm to leadership positions in large, complex class
action cases. The Firm’s leadership in these matters has helped secure relief for more than **50
million** class members.

Over the past 23 years, Joseph Lyon has represented thousands of clients across all fifty states in
consumer class actions, mass torts, and complex individual claims arising from deceptive business
practices, data privacy violations, defective product designs, and corporate neglect.  

The Firm has consistently represented individuals and families in complex litigation involving
personal injury, economic loss, and environmental harm. Joseph has played a significant role in over
100 consumer class actions, many of which advanced novel legal theories involving digital
surveillance and the misuse of confidential healthcare data for marketing purposes.  

Joe has also served in more than 40 multidistrict product liability litigations, helping to secure
substantial compensation for his clients. Much of this work has helped fuel industry reforms that
resulted in safer pharmaceutical, medical device, and consumer products. Several of these cases rank
among the largest mass tort proceedings in history.

For over 20 years, the Firm has focused on high-impact litigation that promotes positive corporate
change and accountability. Recognized as a national leader in complex litigation, the Firm has a
proven history of exposing dangerous business practices and defective products in industries where
regulatory oversight has lagged, thereby bringing attention to serious consumer risks. The Lyon Firm
collaborates with a large network of consumer advocacy groups, experts, whistleblowers, and national

and driven broad industry reforms.

About the firm

## National Class Action & Trial Lawyers

Federal and state courts frequently appoint the Firm to leadership positions in large, complex class
action cases. The Firm’s leadership in these matters has helped secure relief for more than **50
million** class members.

Over the past 23 years, Joseph Lyon has represented thousands of clients across all fifty states in
consumer class actions, mass torts, and complex individual claims arising from deceptive business
practices, data privacy violations, defective product designs, and corporate neglect.  

The Firm has consistently represented individuals and families in complex litigation involving
personal injury, economic loss, and environmental harm. Joseph has played a significant role in over
100 consumer class actions, many of which advanced novel legal theories involving digital
surveillance and the misuse of confidential healthcare data for marketing purposes.  

Joe has also served in more than 40 multidistrict product liability litigations, helping to secure
substantial compensation for his clients. Much of this work has helped fuel industry reforms that
resulted in safer pharmaceutical, medical device, and consumer products. Several of these cases rank
among the largest mass tort proceedings in history.

## **Advancing Corporate Reform & Consumer Justice**

For over 20 years, the Firm has focused on high-impact litigation that promotes positive corporate
change and accountability. Recognized as a national leader in complex litigation, the Firm has a
proven history of exposing dangerous business practices and defective products in industries where
regulatory oversight has lagged, thereby bringing attention to serious consumer risks. The Lyon Firm
collaborates with a large network of consumer advocacy groups, experts, whistleblowers, and national
law firms to promote a safer, more sustainable marketplace while advancing effective compensatory
models for individual clients and class members. Collectively, the Firm’s work has contributed to
numerous high-profile settlements that have generated over **$800 million** in gross value offered
for consumers, secured more than **$550 million** in recovered value for clients and class members,
and driven broad industry reforms.

As a leader in digital health publishing for more than 25 years, WebMD strives to maintain the most
comprehensive and reliable source of health and medical information on the internet.

information platform — and we take that responsibility seriously by:

  Charging our content creators to practice **journalistic principles** of excellence and provide
  objective, accurate, and balanced reporting
* 02
  Maintaining **editorial independence ** and transparency into how we protect the integrity of our
